relationships.subject: Grape seed procyanidins (GSPE)
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrated that clinically used health products, procyanidins, had a significant inhibitory effect to the TLR4-MyD88 signaling pathway

relationships.subject: Grape seed procyanidins (GSPE)
relationships.evidence_quote: GSPE administration downregulated the high level of TLR4 expression in a dose-dependent manner

relationships.subject: Spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with sham group, TLR4, MyD88, IBA1 and phosphorylation of NF-κB-p65 were upregulated in SNL rats which were reversed by procyanidins administration.

key_findings: Oral GSPE reduced mechanical allodynia, thermal hyperalgesia and nerve regeneration in SNL rats.
GSPE reversed SNL-induced TLR4, MyD88, IBA1 and p-NF-κB p65 upregulation and spinal glial activation.
